# A negative main-step budget: during playback the main physics step gets
# DeltaTime minus 1/60 s per catch-up substep (g_CatchupDtBudget). With 50 ms
# passes the float cursor sum lands just below the target in eight of passes
# 11 to 20, which run three substeps and leave about -3.7e-9 s (budget.py
# prints the passes).
settle 0
load pmm swing600.pmm
trace budget.trace
play 0 120
pump 20 50
stop
save pmm budget.pmm
